description.en:
RemovePartyNum_Message with the preset RemoveParty_MessageEx(_rmv_num, _aParamID, _aStReset, 0, 0, 21, 0, "sysmes-remove_party", _not_pt_lock). For each character, the sound effect sys_021 plays (CMND_SND_OPEN_SYS_SE(21)), the system message "sysmes-remove_party" is shown with the character's name filled in, then the character is removed; the next one waits until the sound has finished.
Despite its name, this preset passes a fade of 0, not -1: the BGM is stopped at once and started again at the end (AddParty's NoFadeBGM presets pass -1 and leave the BGM alone).
No shipped script calls it.
Number of characters to remove (read from index 0 of the arrays).
Parameter IDs of the characters to remove.
true to call RemovePartyCmnd(id, reset, false) instead of RemoveParty(id, reset); see RemoveParty for the difference.
